data.narrative:
Nara Space Technology is a public-stage company in the Space & Aerospace sector that has raised approximately $25M (KRW 33.5B) to date. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comps (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Planet Labs, Astroscale, and SpaceX, though no single peer perfectly mirrors Nara's profile within the same developmental tier.

Standard triangulation methods face material constraints. Peer-median comparison is inapplicable because the narrow filter of same-stage and adjacent-stage peers yields fewer than 3 datapoints; while 11 same-sector peers exist, none cluster meaningfully by stage or valuation tier. Public-comp anchoring using the Space & Aerospace P/S median of 23.9x across the 6-ticker universe cannot proceed without Nara's disclosed revenue—standard for private companies but necessary to apply the multiple.

The absence of both a sufficiently dense peer set at comparable development stages and critical financial disclosures (revenue) prevents a quantitatively grounded valuation range from this dataset alone. Any range would rest on assumptions beyond the provided data. To advance the analysis, either (1) Nara's revenue or comparable operating metrics must surface, or (2) the peer set must be expanded to capture sufficient same-stage or similar-tier comparables within Space & Aerospace. The $25M raised to date establishes a floor, but does not itself constitute a fair-value anchor.
